scoring: Interval recall (non-benign cases only) and benign false-alarm rate (benign cases only) are scored separately, each against its own threshold. Both must pass; neither can offset the other. Scoring logic is imported unchanged from scripts/execution_eval.py (score, expected_omissions).
interval_recall: Recovered expected omission intervals divided by all expected omission intervals. Temporal IoU >= 0.5 and edit-position error <= 1 second, one-to-one matching. Audio-only deletions require audio matches.
benign_false_alarm_rate: Benign edits with at least one predicted internal omission divided by all benign edits. Boundary-only trims are benign.
scope: Nine CC BY 2.0 BE FOSDEM 2022 Python-devroom talks (real speech with slides/screen content), first 270 s of each, clipped and edited. Edits are scripted by ffmpeg from the recipes below, so labels are exact by construction. They measure deleted media, not whether a deletion changes meaning. Deterministic aligner only: no Muse calls, no API cost. The domain-admission gate (backend/context_core/domain_policy.py) is not part of this path: the eval imports analyze() and grounded_omissions() directly. SAM is not used and contributes nothing.
exclusion_policy: Sources may be excluded only before any pipeline run, for technical reasons (no audio/video stream or corrupt file), recorded in sources.json. No source or case is dropped after a pipeline run.
crop_note: A pure crop (crop_benign) removes no time and is labelled benign, matching execution-v1: the temporal aligner must not report an omission. crop_omission combines a cut with a crop.
